title: DFV, Housing Instability, and Homelessness
description: This module explores the relationship between domestic and family violence, housing instability, and homelessness. It supports practitioners to recognise risk factors, barriers to safe housing, and pathways to stability.
outcomes: Understand how DFV contributes to housing instability and homelessness
Recognise barriers to accessing safe housing
Identify pathways to safety and stability for victim-survivors
